description: This source file implements functions for converting native POSIX file mode bits to a custom Git-specific representation and provides wrapper functions for file status system calls (stat, fstat, lstat) that apply this conversion.

methods.name: mode_t mode_native_to_git(mode_t native_mode)
methods.description: Converts native POSIX mode_t to a Git-specific mode representation, handling different file types based on system macros.

methods.name: int git_stat(const char * path,struct stat * buf)
methods.description: Wrapper around stat() that converts the mode bits of the retrieved file status to Git format.

methods.name: int git_fstat(int fd,struct stat * buf)
methods.description: Wrapper around fstat() that applies mode conversion to the file descriptor.

methods.name: int git_lstat(const char * path,struct stat * buf)
methods.description: Wrapper around lstat() that applies mode conversion for symbolic links among other file types.
